provenance: SWE-bench Lite, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct. Verbatim endpoints from Brown et al. 2024 'Large Language Monkeys': coverage 15.9% at 1 sample -> 56% at 250 samples, beating the single-sample SOTA of 43%. Coverage grows ~log-linearly: y = 15.9 + 16.72*log10(k); intermediate points computed from that fit. y = coverage (pass@k, %); x = samples k.
